content: {"reasoning":"The documented CO-97 denial treats this service as bundled into another paid service, not as deductible or coinsurance owed by the patient. Records submission and peer-to-peer review have already been attempted, and no current denial, information request, or identified claim error supports another available rework action. Although patient billing performed well in similar claims, that tally does not establish contractual patient liability here; the bundled balance should be written off.","action":"write_off"}
